blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) attempted to “forcibly” bring former Davao City information officer Jeffrey Tupas to Manila in exchange for money and other promises, Vice President Sara Duterte said Tuesday. Tupas was among the individuals mentioned by former police officer Rodulfo Gracioso Jr., who claimed he delivered suitcases filled with cash to Duterte on orders from former House Speaker Lord Allan Velasco, for whom he served as an aide. “Tupas himself told me that when NBI agents attempted to forcibly take him away in North Cotabato on September 29, 2026, his family was promised money, a […]...
